author: Unity
description: There are few things more fun than playing games with your friends! Got an awesome idea for the next great friendslop, but don't want to wrestle with networking code for weeks? Corrie Green joins us as we dig into Unity's new First Person Multiplayer sample; a small, minimalistic project built to be the foundation for your next multiplayer masterpiece. By the end of the stream, you'll have everything you need to grab the sample and start building on top of it yourself!
title: Making a Co-Op Game in a Flash! | New Unity Sample Project
